moveToApplications.title: Move ScreenMint to Applications
moveToApplications.message: Move ScreenMint to /Applications for more stable macOS capture permissions.
moveToApplications.detail: Unsigned macOS builds keep Screen Recording permissions more reliably when ScreenMint stays installed at /Applications/ScreenMint.app. Running from Downloads, Desktop, or a mounted DMG can cause repeated prompts and blank source lists.
moveToApplications.manualMessage: Move ScreenMint to /Applications before using screen capture.
moveToApplications.manualDetail: macOS did not move the app automatically. Drag ScreenMint.app into /Applications, then relaunch it from there.
